answer: Violet layered bonds stop bulk fakes with stacked cost. Each agent posts a 70-credit bond in three layers: a violet base seal, a dawn work receipt each epoch, and a zephyr reading on the public log. Each layer needs a fresh serial; reuse burns the stack. First 45, then 45+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,542,500 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool; honest pay 45 once. A rented-layer ring fails: one dawn receipt cannot cover many violet seals.
